Class Tile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.board.Tile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
OrderTile
public class Tile extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a tile on the game board. Instances of this class are intended to be created from JSON data.

  • Constructor Details

    • Tile

      public Tile()
      Default constructor for Tile. The constructor is empty as instances of this class will be populated using JSON deserialization.

    • Tile

      public Tile(Player p, int upperPicks, int bottomPicks)
      Constructs an occupied tile assigned to a player.
      Parameters:
      p - the player occupying the tile
      upperPicks - the number of picks granted from the top row
      bottomPicks - the number of picks granted from the bottom row

    • Tile

      public Tile(TileId id, int upperPicks, int bottomPicks, int foodBonus, int minPlayers)
      Test-only constructor that fully specifies a tile.
      Parameters:
      id - the tile id
      upperPicks - the number of picks granted from the top row
      bottomPicks - the number of picks granted from the bottom row
      foodBonus - the food bonus granted by the tile
      minPlayers - the minimum number of players for the tile to be in play
